about: Originals of the product images. Each entry says where the image came from. Images marked "ai" are shown on the site with the caption "Representative image". When you replace one with a real photograph of the product, change its source to "photo" (or delete the entry) and run: python _src/process-photos.py, then node _src/build.mjs
generator: Google Gemini 3 Pro Image (gemini-3-pro-image-preview), 4:5 at 2K, 10 October 2026, prompts in _src/photo-prompts.mjs
